item.title: Gulf countries angry at US over lack of warning before Iran strikes
item.description: Gulf allies have criticised the US for failing to warn them before strikes on Iran that triggered retaliatory drone and missile attacks across the region. They said their air defence resources are being stretched.

item.title: BYD launches second-gen Blade Battery with ultra-fast FLASH charging tech
item.description: BYD have launched a second-generation Blade Battery that promises 10 per cent to 70 per cent state of charge in just five minutes, while reaching 97 per cent in just nine minutes under standard conditions.

item.title: ‘Dhongi baba’: Navjot Singh Sidhu slams Pakistan pacer Mohammad Amir over failed India prediction
item.description: Former India cricketer Navjot Singh Sidhu slammed Mohammad Amir after the Men in Blue reached the T20 World Cup final despite the Pakistan fast bowler predicting otherwise.

item.title: Karnataka plans social media ban for children under 16 in new Budget
item.description: Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has announced plans to ban social media access for children below 16 years. The proposal, revealed during the state budget speech for 2026–27, aims to reduce the negative effects of rising mobile phone usage among young users.

item.title: Women’s Day drawing ideas for kids: Simple sketches celebrating strength and dreams
item.description: International Women’s Day 2026 offers children a creative way to celebrate the strength, kindness and achievements of women through meaningful drawings. Here are ideas that highlight inspiration, imagination and appreciation for women in everyday life.

item.title: Nvidia reportedly ends H200 chip output for China as focus shifts to Vera Rubin AI chips
item.description: Nvidia has reportedly stopped producing its H200 AI chips intended for the Chinese market. The company has shifted manufacturing capacity at TSMC to its upcoming next-generation AI hardware platform, Vera Rubin.

item.title: ‘I won’t be at peace until my family returns safely’ Dehradun families wait for stranded relatives in Iran
item.description: Families in Dehradun’s Ambadi village are deeply worried as their relatives remain stranded in Iran amid the Israel-Iran conflict. With only brief phone calls for reassurance, they plead for government intervention to ensure safe return.

item.title: SSC implements seat fix-float system; here’s what the rule says, how to avail benefits
item.description: This new system will reduce the number of vacant positions and allow candidates to choose posts better suited to the merit and preferences.

item.title: PPF & SSY minimum deposit: Act by March 31, 2026 to avoid penalties & default
item.description: Invested in Public Provident Fund (PPF) or Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)? Ensure you deposit the mandatory minimum amount by March 31, 2026, to keep your accounts active.

item.title: Scorching heat grips Tamil Nadu: Multiple districts record over 100°F, isolated rain likely in Western Ghats
item.description: The entire state of Tamil Nadu will face scorching heat during April and May, with temperatures expected to rise significantly above normal levels. Tenkasi-based meteorologist Raja has indicated that although summer officially ends in May, the heat is likely to persist until August this year.
